description: Shared settings for every algorithm (fair comparison). One map per (distribution, node count, seed); map seed = algorithm seed; every algorithm runs on the identical map with a fresh instance.

excluded_algorithms.MEACO: stopped at the user's request (not used in the study); partial ME-ACO files in raw_data are ignored by summarize.py and plot_results.py

energy_model: src/hparameter.py HyperParameters defaults (P_0=0.1, E_elec=5e-8, E_integrate=5e-9, 30 kHz, k=1.5, 200-bit packets, 10 kbps); only T_max is overridden
